clusters.headline: President Trump Signals Preference For Diplomacy Regarding Iran
aiSummaryBullets: President Donald Trump stated that ordering fresh military strikes against Iran is unlikely if diplomatic efforts move forward.
The administration reportedly identifies the conflict as a priority for upcoming discussions with international leaders including the Prime Minister of Qatar.

clusters.headline: Explosions Reported In Strait Of Hormuz Amidst Diplomatic Efforts
aiSummaryBullets: Explosions were reported on Qeshm Island and on tankers following encounters with sea mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
Iran has officially removed the previous 2,000-kilometer range restriction on its ballistic missile program.
